receipts.label: plan339 integrated control corpora and lifecycle
plan339 final M0 repeated cold warm
plan339 final bounded cold warm and lifecycle smoke

M1.phaseRegression: Reject a median increase above max(1 ms, baseline maximum minus baseline minimum), using the five frozen baseline samples for that phase and startup condition.
M1.memory: Reject a matched whole-job peak at least twice baseline, unless the smaller-memory variant meets the latency target.

thresholds.totalWorkProxy: Sum each sample worker parse/query elapsed durations and main-thread union work. This is a diagnostic work proxy, not CPU seconds or elapsed open time.

limits: Controls have one sample each and establish output correctness, not latency distributions.
RSS is a 100 ms sampled simultaneous sum over pre-open browser process IDs and includes shared-page double counting.
Scheduler memory peaks cover each whole batch, including controller, browser, hashes, traces and lifecycle work.
One declared server remained running during each quiet job; new admissions were excluded with the admission lock.
WASM capacity is committed bytes; allocator-live bytes remain unmeasured.
Runtime WASM was rebuilt byte-identically; grammar WASMs were pinned and hashed but were not byte-identically rebuilt.

Control runs precede the empty-process-list RSS guard and its formatting. Every recorded process list is nonempty, and all measured browser asset hashes equal the final baseline. Each control retains its own benchmark fingerprint.
The final unused-export gate made readProcessRss private after these measurements. Its implementation, call sites and measured browser assets are unchanged.
